decisions.reason: A net price display plugin sits close to the core shop offer and costs little to maintain, and with the industry growing and the firm hiring there is enough slack and no performance shortfall to trigger dropping it.
An ERP interface plugin is valuable for the firm's end-to-end and multichannel strategy and likely supports client retention, so it meets aspirations.
Price comparison tracking matches the paid advertising and analytics services, and the cheap upkeep makes keeping it acceptable while results are still uncertain.
This is one of several overlapping price comparison plugins, so it risks consolidation, but a single year gives too little evidence of a shortfall to justify search.
This overlapping price comparison tracking plugin may later be consolidated, but slack and growing demand allow the firm to carry it for now.
A net price reporting plugin complements Product A for B2B shops at low cost, and nothing indicates a performance gap.
